financials_interim.notes: COMPANY (standalone) basis -- no discontinued operations at Company level (Lanka Swisstek Pvt Ltd, the India subsidiary held for sale, is a Group-consolidated entity, not directly held by the Company in a way that generates a separate discontinued-ops line here). EPS 0.95 = 252,379k/265,252,050 confirmed via the accounting identity PBT(308,748)-tax(56,369)=PAT(252,379) exact match, and operating_profit(145,711) solved via PBT=op_profit+fin_income-fin_costs+share_of_associate exact match. See GROUP row's notes for the full extraction-ambiguity explanation shared by both rows.

Lanka Tiles PLC. IMPORTANT EXTRACTION NOTE: this filing's P&L (both Group and Company) was rendered TWICE in the source PDF's text layer with the two renderings showing the two comparative years in OPPOSITE column order relative to each other (a genuine dual-extraction artifact, not a data error in the filing itself). The correct year-to-value mapping used here was established via THREE independent cross-checks, all of which agreed: (1) the Statement of Changes in Equity, a single unambiguous table, directly gives the quarter's profit-for-period/NCI/attributable-to-parent split for each of the two 'Balance as at 30 June' transition rows; (2) the standalone 'Discontinued Operations' note (p.6) gives an unambiguous single table for the India/Lanka Swisstek Pvt Ltd results; (3) EPS = attributable profit / 265,252,050 shares was checked against both the 'total' and 'continuing operations' EPS figures printed in the filing. All three independently confirm: 2026 Group profit-for-period attributable to parent = 248,114k (2025: 152,220k); 2026 discontinued-operations loss = 6,921k (2025 loss: 18,365k, i.e. the loss narrowed YoY); 2026 continuing-operations PAT = 251,644k (2025: 161,586k). profit_before_tax/tax_expense/operating_profit/finance figures below were then solved via the accounting identity (operating_profit + finance_income - finance_costs + share_of_associate = PBT; PBT - tax = PAT), which resolved to an EXACT match for PBT, finance income (matching the filing's own printed +353% change), and share of associate profit (matching the filing's own printed +129%/+128% change) -- these exact/near-exact matches are strong confirmation the resolved figures are correct. Revenue/cost_of_sales/gross_profit for 2026 (2,650,180 / 1,703,644 / 946,536) could not be tied to the operating_profit figure to the exact rupee via the distribution/admin expense breakdown (a ~34,000k gap remains unexplained, likely a further transcription slip in a line item -- distribution/administrative expenses -- that is NOT a stored field in this schema and does not affect any figure entered below); revenue is used with high but not 100% confidence and this gap is disclosed for transparency. Group and Company revenue/COGS/GP are identical (Company IS effectively the Flooring & Tile segment; Aluminium and other diversification sits in equity-accounted associates Swisstek (Ceylon) PLC and CP Holdings (Pvt) Ltd, not consolidated line-by-line). The Group has a discontinued operation (Lanka Swisstek (Pvt) Ltd, 51%-owned India flooring operations, held for sale since 25 Nov 2025) -- PAT figures below (Group) are TOTAL for the period (continuing + discontinued), matching the filing's headline 'Profit/(Loss) for the period' line, not the continuing-operations-only subtotal. minority_interest = NCI's share of total profit for the period (a loss both periods: -3,391 in 2026, -8,999 in 2025). short_term_borrowings = current 'Interest bearing liabilities' + 'Bank Overdrafts'. long_term_borrowings = non-current 'Interest bearing liabilities'. capex = 'Acquisition of property, plant and equipment' per the cash flow statement, which (unlike the P&L) had only ONE clean, unambiguous rendering.

interim_updates.note_text: Lanka Tiles' Group revenue from continuing operations fell 8.5% YoY to Rs.2.65bn for Q1 FY2026/27 (quarter ended 30 June 2026), and Results from Operating Activities fell 4.6% to Rs.145.0mn (from Rs.151.9mn) as gross profit fell 8.4% roughly in line with revenue. Despite this operating softness, PBT from continuing operations rose sharply, +59.8% to Rs.308.0mn, driven by two large non-operating swings: Finance income jumped 353% (Rs.16.2mn to Rs.73.3mn) and the Share of net profit of associate (Swisstek (Ceylon) PLC and CP Holdings) rose 129% (Rs.49.3mn to Rs.112.7mn) -- together these more than offset both the revenue decline and a higher tax charge (+80.8% to Rs.56.4mn). The Group also continued to wind down its India flooring operations: Lanka Swisstek (Pvt) Ltd (51%-owned, held for sale since 25 November 2025) contributed a discontinued-operations loss of Rs.6.9mn, narrower than the Rs.18.4mn loss a year earlier. Including discontinued operations, Group profit for the period rose 70.9% YoY to Rs.244.7mn, with the full amount effectively accruing to equity holders of the parent (Rs.248.1mn, +63.0%) since non-controlling interests absorbed a Rs.3.4mn loss (narrower than the Rs.9.0mn NCI loss a year earlier).
interim_updates.gaps_note: No QoQ comparison possible: no quarter closer to this one has been collected for TILE -- this is the first financial_statements entry for this symbol. This filing's P&L had a genuine dual-rendering column-order ambiguity requiring cross-checking against the Statement of Changes in Equity, the Discontinued Operations note, and EPS arithmetic to resolve reliably (documented in full in the financial_statements notes field) -- revenue/cost_of_sales/gross_profit are used with high but not 100%-exact confidence, since a ~Rs.34mn gap could not be closed against the (non-stored) distribution/administrative expense breakdown; profit_before_tax, tax_expense, profit_after_tax, operating_profit, finance_income, finance_costs and EPS were all independently verified via exact accounting-identity matches and are high-confidence.
interim_updates.takeaway: The strong PBT and PAT growth this quarter is driven almost entirely by two non-operating items -- a 353% jump in finance income and a 129% jump in the associate-profit share -- while the core continuing business actually contracted (revenue -8.5%, operating profit -4.6%). This is the same 'core weakness masked by a non-operating swing' pattern seen at several other companies processed this session; the one genuinely positive operating signal is the narrowing loss at the India discontinued operation as it winds down toward disposal.

operational_highlights: Group revenue (continuing operations) -8.5% YoY to Rs.2.65bn; Results from Operating Activities -4.6% to Rs.145.0mn
PBT from continuing operations +59.8% YoY to Rs.308.0mn, driven by Finance income +353% (Rs.16.2mn to Rs.73.3mn) and Share of associate profit +129% (Rs.49.3mn to Rs.112.7mn)
Discontinued operations (Lanka Swisstek Pvt Ltd, India, held for sale since 25 Nov 2025): loss narrowed to Rs.6.9mn from Rs.18.4mn a year earlier
Total Group profit for the period +70.9% YoY to Rs.244.7mn; virtually all of it attributable to equity holders of the parent (Rs.248.1mn, +63.0%) as non-controlling interests absorbed a Rs.3.4mn loss
Tax expense +80.8% YoY to Rs.56.4mn, a headwind that was still more than offset by the finance-income and associate-profit swings
key_drivers: Finance income +353% YoY (Rs.16.2mn to Rs.73.3mn) is the single largest driver of the PBT increase -- a non-operating item, not attributable to the tile/flooring business itself

Share of net profit of associate (Swisstek (Ceylon) PLC and CP Holdings (Pvt) Ltd) +129% YoY (Rs.49.3mn to Rs.112.7mn) is the second major non-operating driver -- consistent with Swisstek (Ceylon) PLC's own strong quarter this period (PARQ, entered separately this session, showed Group PBT +46.9% YoY)

Core continuing-operations revenue declined 8.5% YoY with operating profit down a further 4.6%, indicating genuine softness in the tile/flooring business itself this quarter, obscured by the two non-operating swings above
The India discontinued operation's narrowing loss (Rs.18.4mn to Rs.6.9mn) is a real, if minor, operational improvement as the disposal process proceeds

_gaps: ebitda: depreciation_amortization not disclosed; EBITDA understated (= operating profit only)
